mathematical_inputs.source: Shawn Krisman, The reciprocal cube sums of Lucas sequences of quadratic units are irrational, Hexagon 2611.00491v1 (2026)
mathematical_inputs.use: Ordinary theorem and its scope, Section 2 moments, Proposition 3.1, formal cyclotomic clearing in Proposition 4.4 and the exponent estimates in the proof of Proposition 4.6, the conjugate pole function in Proposition 5.1, and the interpolation argument of Proposition 6.1.

mathematical_inputs.source: Shawn Krisman, The sum of the reciprocal cubes of the Fibonacci numbers is irrational, Hexagon 2611.00473v1 (2026)
mathematical_inputs.use: Ordinary Fibonacci cube sum and the quadratic-order antecedent of the Lucas construction.

mathematical_inputs.source: uplift-universal-inc, Irrationality of the Lambert-series value ζ_{1/p}(3), research draft of 12 October 2026
mathematical_inputs.use: The second derivative on a geometric lattice and nonvanishing for moving denominators by comparing consecutive rational interpolants, especially Sections 2 and 5.

mathematical_inputs.source: Wadim Zudilin, A determinantal approach to irrationality, Constructive Approximation 45 (2017), 301–310
mathematical_inputs.use: Polynomial Hankel irrationality criterion in Proposition 2 and the fixed-moment Kronecker criterion recalled in Section 5.

mathematical_inputs.source: Christian Krattenthaler, A determinant identity for moments of orthogonal polynomials that implies Uvarov’s formula for the orthogonal polynomials of rationally related densities, arXiv:2103.03969v1 (2021)
mathematical_inputs.use: Theorem 1 as an antecedent for Hankel determinants of rationally modified moments.

mathematical_inputs.source: V. B. Uvarov, The connection between systems of polynomials orthogonal with respect to different distribution functions, USSR Computational Mathematics and Mathematical Physics 9 (1969), no. 6, 25–36.
mathematical_inputs.use: Section 1 of the Russian original relates orthogonal polynomials for measures that differ by a rational factor. This is the classical change of weight behind Krattenthaler’s determinant identity.

mathematical_inputs.source: Leopold Kronecker, Zur Theorie der Elimination einer Variabeln aus zwei algebraischen Gleichungen, Monatsberichte der Königlich Preussischen Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Berlin (1881), 535–600.
mathematical_inputs.use: Article VII develops the recurrence criterion. Article IX, pp. 153–154 in the collected-works reprint, identifies rational Laurent series with eventual vanishing of the principal Hankel determinants for a fixed moment sequence. Section 5 of the manuscript uses consecutive interpolation problems for its varying denominators.

literature_comparisons.source: Duverney, Ke. Nishioka, Ku. Nishioka and Shiokawa, Proc. Japan Acad. Ser. A 73 (1997), 140–142
literature_comparisons.statement_checked_in: The authors’ RIMS Kôkyûroku 1060 (1998), Theorem 4 on printed page 95. For Q=-1, the reciprocal sum over odd indices is transcendental for every positive integer power.

literature_comparisons.source: Elsner, Shimomura and Shiokawa, Algebraic relations for reciprocal sums of Fibonacci numbers, Acta Arithmetica 130 (2007), 37–60
literature_comparisons.use: Theorems 2 and 4 concern alternating even powers for first- and second-kind Lucas sequences.
